note: Credit and provenance for every asset under ui/board_v2/. Kept in the same machine-readable shape as ui/assets/attribution.json and ui/assets-gothic/attribution.json, so one reader answers the licence question for any tree in this repository.
reproducibility: Every file here is script output and regenerable. The recipe is recorded per file and was checked, not just quoted: re-running it reproduces the committed bytes exactly.

project-generated.name: Generated by a script in this repository. Nothing traced, photographed or diffused, and no model-generated content is in the file, so there is no upstream licence to honour and nothing to attribute. Where the design was arrived at with an assistant, the file's `design` note says so -- a record of how the decisions were reached, not a rights claim.

layout_lab/assets/duty_wheel_v2.svg.title: Duty wheel v2, at aspect 1.887
layout_lab/assets/duty_wheel_v2.svg.creator: Generated by tools/ui_debug/build_duty_wheel_v2.py
layout_lab/assets/duty_wheel_v2.svg.source: A SEPARATE BUILD, not a copy of the 1.778 baseline in tools/ui_debug/prototypes/duty_wheel_v2.svg -- that one is viewBox 1000 x 562.4 and this is 1000 x 529.9. The faces are rebuilt from the ellipse at the new aspect rather than squashed. Vendored here and read as bytes so the layout lab imports nothing from tools/ui_debug, whose builder parses argv at import time and needs numpy.
layout_lab/assets/duty_wheel_v2.svg.design: Proportions and palette arrived at by iteration in project sessions with Claude (Anthropic): 1.887 chosen over the builder's default 1.778, the 32 degree elevation that follows from it, and the recolour from the builder's parchment into slate. The decisions were the author's. The file itself is deterministic output of the builder and contains no model-generated content -- no raster data, nothing traced or diffused, only computed vector geometry.
layout_lab/assets/duty_wheel_v2.svg.role: the drawing the layout lab composes the module around. generate_layout_lab.py reads it as bytes, recolours it to slate at build time, and refuses any aspect more than 0.0005 from the design ratio.
layout_lab/assets/duty_wheel_v2.svg.recipe: python3 tools/ui_debug/build_duty_wheel_v2.py --aspect 1.887 --out duty_wheel_v2_1887_layout.json, then render with tools.ui_debug.render_duty_wheel_v2.render_duty_wheel_v2_svg(lay, standalone=True) from tools/ui_debug/duty_wheel_v2_1887_layout.json. See ui/board_v2/layout_lab/README.md for the exact snippet.
